t: You're at Norland Place School, an independent preparatory school in Holland Park for boys and girls aged four to eleven. It was founded in 1876 by Emily Lord, who later became Emily Ward. She was a pioneer of childcare education in England and founded several institutions, including this school and, most notably, the Norland Institute. So a school for young children here grew from someone who spent her career thinking about how children should be cared for and taught.
